# Lina House

> Lina House is a surf camp and hostel in Imsouane, Morocco, 500m from Magic Bay — home to the longest wave in Africa.

Lina House offers affordable stays (€13–€50/night) with a homemade restaurant, rooftop terrace overlooking the ocean, surf lessons, and board rental. Rated 9.7/10 from 256 reviews. Available in English (/en) and French (/fr).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://linahouse-imsouane.com/en): Overview of Lina House, location, amenities, and highlights.

- [Restaurant](https://linahouse-imsouane.com/en/restaurant): Homemade Moroccan meals served on the rooftop terrace.
